copy.title: The Rihanna Money File
copy.desc: An interactive, fully sourced map of Rihanna’s family: Fenty Beauty, Savage X Fenty, the homes, the talks over LVMH’s half, and the money on the public record.
copy.eyebrow: File #019 · The Fenty family · Data as of
copy.h1: She became a billionaire selling makeup. We followed the money.
copy.lede: Who’s who, what she owns, which companies you can buy stock in, the homes, and the money on the public record. Every number links to its source.
copy.familyLede: Tap anyone to open their file: what they own, what’s on the record, and where every fact comes from. Rihanna and A$AP Rocky’s three children appear by first name only.
copy.investLede: Her companies are private. The public company on this map is LVMH, which owns the other half of Fenty Beauty; the family has no stake in it.
copy.moneyLede: Most of it is her half of Fenty Beauty, plus about 28% of Savage X Fenty, Forbes says. She’s the only one here with a published net worth.
copy.homesLede: Seven homes she bought from 2009 to 2023, with what she paid and, for four of them, what she sold them for. Neighborhood level only.
copy.recordLede: What funding rounds, reporting on the Fenty Beauty sale talks, and court filings show. Filings and reporting, not guesses.
copy.trailLede: From Barbados to a billion-dollar beauty fortune.

summary.t: Rihanna named her charity, the Clara Lionel Foundation, for them when she started it in 2012.
A Barbadian warehouse supervisor. He and Monica divorced when Rihanna was 14.
Singer born Robyn Rihanna Fenty. Forbes says she’s a billionaire thanks to Fenty Beauty, the makeup line she launched with LVMH in 2017. She also founded the lingerie brand Savage X Fenty.

owns.t: Owns half; LVMH owns the other half.
Founder and executive chair. Forbes estimates her stake at about 28%.

record.h: The sale talks over Fenty Beauty
record.t: In October 2025 Reuters reported that LVMH was exploring a sale of its 50% stake, and that the company could be valued at $1 billion to $2 billion. In June 2026, MarcyPen Capital Partners, co-founded by Jay-Z, was reported to be in talks to buy it.

The lingerie brand raised $115 million at a $1 billion valuation in February 2021 and $125 million more in January 2022, and later weighed an IPO at $3 billion or more. She stepped down as CEO in June 2023 and became executive chair.

record.h: The case against her father’s company
record.t: In 2019 she sued her father and his business partner over their company’s use of her name. She dropped the case in September 2021, before it went to trial.

facts.t: Forbes first counted her as a billionaire in August 2021, worth $1.7 billion, the richest female musician in the world at the time.
She signed a $25 million deal with Samsung in late 2015 to promote its Galaxy phones.
Her 2023 Super Bowl halftime show drew about 121 million viewers.
Barbados named her a National Hero in November 2021.

kidsNote.t: Rihanna and A$AP Rocky have three children: RZA, Riot and Rocki. We list first names only.

summary.t: Rapper born Rakim Mayers in Harlem. He founded the creative agency AWGE in 2014 and launched a whisky brand, Mercer + Prince, in 2022.

facts.t: He confirmed his relationship with Rihanna in a GQ interview in May 2021.
As of 2025 he was creative director for Puma F1 and Ray-Ban.

companies.name: Fenty Beauty
companies.t: Launched in 2017 with LVMH’s Kendo beauty incubator. Net sales were about $450 million in 2024. LVMH has been exploring a sale of its half.

companies.name: Savage X Fenty
companies.t: Lingerie brand. Valued at $1 billion in a 2021 funding round; it weighed an IPO at $3 billion or more in 2022.

companies.name: LVMH
companies.who: Owns the other half of Fenty Beauty. The family has no stake in LVMH.
companies.t: The French luxury group launched Fenty Beauty with Rihanna in 2017 and owns 50% of it.
